source.title: Shinners & Mahler's Illustrated Flora of North Central Texas
source.authors: Diggs, G. M. Jr.; Lipscomb, B. L.; O'Kennon, R. J.

morphology_documented.habit: Deciduous small tree to about 12 m
morphology_documented.leaves: Obovate to broadly ovate simple blades 6–12 × 3–6 cm; sharply often doubly serrate in 1999 key
morphology_documented.flowers: White in clusters of 2–4(–6), opening before or with young leaves
morphology_documented.habitat: Woods and thickets on various soils

source_scope_note: Species-level and key-level traits distinguished; modern secondary traits stay attributed to their own sources.
unresolved_taxonomy_or_source_notes: Compared with P. angustifolia: usually tree-form versus smaller shrub, larger leaves and darker glaucous mature fruits
Rust relationship with Anemone berlandieri noted elsewhere in flora but not an identification diagnostic
